prompts.opportunity-workshop: Edit the attached photograph to create a photorealistic EMPTY background plate for the same Opportunity dealership workshop used-car photography bay. This image is the edit target and sole reference for the room: preserve the SAME existing real space, wall layout, perspective and viewing direction, off-white wall panels with their slim vertical seams on the left and across the rear, the large dark gray ribbed industrial garage door in the upper-right rear, the open doorway and soft out-of-focus workshop details at far right, the pale gray large-format tiled floor with its diagonal perspective seams, the same soft bright overhead/daylight lighting and naturally shallow background depth of field. REMOVE the ENTIRE black SUV, its wheels, mirrors and vehicle shadow/reflections. Plausibly reconstruct only the areas of wall, door and floor which it occluded. Remove the web gallery arrow button, black outside margin and rounded corner frame; expand the actual photographic interior to clean rectangular image edges. Keep the space empty for later compositing another vehicle. Do NOT redesign the room, do NOT add an OPPORTUNITY wall plaque, logo, text, banners, extra windows, furnishings or a new showroom. Preserve unobtrusive far-right existing workshop clutter in soft focus as in the source. No vehicles, no people, no UI, no watermark. Landscape 3:2 empty room photograph suitable as a 1536x1024 car listing background. Room photography only, not a collage.

Bright white seamless automotive photo studio, white smooth rear wall, pale gray matte floor, subtle curved wall-to-floor sweep, broad diffused softbox lighting, no visible lighting fixtures. A discreet black rectangular Opportunity dealership plaque high on the upper-left part of the wall. Use the attached reference ONLY as the visual brand reference for the wall plaque: faithfully reproduce its white wordmark "OPPORTUNITY" and small line "Autocentrum Brno-Líšeň" on a charcoal rectangle. Logo must be confined to upper-left wall, small but legible, clear of the central vehicle placement area. No car, no vehicle, no people, no furniture, no plants, no banners, no other logos, no watermarks, no collage, no mock UI. Output is a reusable background photo, not an advertisement poster.
